youtube.description:
Move from VS Code to Kiro in 4 steps (settings, themes, extensions)

Four steps to move from VS Code to Kiro.

1. It feels familiar - Kiro is built on Code OSS.
2. Migrate your profile - Bring your settings and themes over.
3. Check extensions - Extensions come from Open VSX.
4. Start a spec - Then add what VS Code never had.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/upgrade-guides/migrating-from-vscode/
